::: {#exr-fine-tune}

#### Training every layer from the reused weights

`new_head(train_all=True)` returns all the [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) of the copy,
so training changes the [convolutional layers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/cnn-rnn.html#def-convolutional-layer) too,
starting from the weights they learned on the digits 0 to 4.
Trained this way on the 20 images of each draw,
is the network more accurate than with the convolutional layers kept fixed?

:::
